state_authority: Existing CORE_DB application job/project revisions; learner creates no database or storage service

algorithm.state: Sorted declared numeric observation keys discretized by fixed strictly increasing threshold tuples with bisect_right
algorithm.update: Q(s,a) += alpha * (clipped sum of declared reward components + gamma * max Q(next_state) unless terminated - Q(s,a))
algorithm.truncation: A truncated episode ends collection but preserves the nonterminal bootstrap target
algorithm.exploration: Seeded epsilon-greedy; committed episode count controls bounded epsilon decay; ties use declared action order
algorithm.inference: Greedy action plus exact Q values and visit counts; no calibrated probability or general intelligence claim

durability.checkpoint_boundary: Complete episode only; uncommitted episode Q updates, random state and cursors are rolled back on cancellation or checkpoint callback failure
durability.snapshot: Canonical SHA256-bound complete Q table, exact visits, optimizer config, environment descriptor, runtime identity, seed ledger, source lineage, episode cursor and trace digest history
durability.callback: Existing authority atomically persists candidate snapshot and episode trace after worker/version/rights checks; learner treats successful callback return as commitment
durability.recovery: Restore strict full snapshot; do not reapply committed episodes; restart may replay only the uncommitted episode
durability.fork: Explicit new candidate requires a parent with committed current-job learning updates, copies exact parent Q/visits, pins full parent snapshot digest and policy identity, retains inherited episode/seed ledger, resets only current-job counters and RNG/config. Per-job and lifetime usage bounds remain separate; no parent or production policy mutation
durability.fences: Application authority supplies cancellation, authorization and atomic checkpoint callbacks; no child writes or authority created by learner

offline_trace.validation: Exact environment descriptor and source lineage, or exact original lineage in policy source_lineage.admitted_traces keyed by the complete trace digest; finite typed observations/rewards, action membership, sequential continuous observation chain, terminal/truncated last transition, exact component sum, return and canonical UTF8 JSON digest
offline_trace.admitted_traces: Bounded 256-entry immutable trace-digest-to-original-lineage map populated only by existing authenticated backend from current rights-scoped source bundles; it grants no independent rights authority
offline_trace.evidence: Imported transitions are supplied evidence; Q updates are real execution but imported rewards are not relabeled as simulator-measured returns

evaluation.execution: Fresh actual environments, paired disjoint held-out seeds, greedy candidate versus seeded uniform-random or explicitly supplied parent policy
evaluation.measures: Raw component return, episode steps, termination/truncation rates, paired return difference and trace identities
evaluation.mutation: No Q updates and no training RNG/cursor changes
evaluation.promotion: Candidate evidence only; improvement is never assumed and no production promotion is performed

failure: Malformed or substituted snapshots/traces, foreign environment/config/lineage, exhausted states/steps/episodes/bytes, nonfinite arithmetic, cancellation and rejected authority callbacks fail explicitly before committing the next episode
limitations: Bounded tabular local control policy, not neural all-game learning or universal hardware emulation. Rights/provenance remain application-owned. Snapshot digests detect byte corruption but do not authenticate a malicious issuer. Runtime interruption within an episode replays that episode.
verification: User directs no tests. Static compilation/lint only during this implementation session; future executed acceptance evidence required.
